[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born on 2 Apr 1786 in Kirkliston, West Lothian, Scotland, son of [[Glasgow-159|John Glasgow]] and [[Gray-6937|Agnes (Gray) Glasgow]].<ref>Old Parish Records - Thomas Glasgow - KIRKLISTON	/WEST LOTHIAN, Year 1786 Reference 667/00 0020 020</ref>

Thomas married [[Burns-2926|Euphemia Burns]]  on 1 Nov 1828 in Aberlady, East Lothian. 

In the 1841 census Peter (age 12) was in Ballencrieff, Aberlady, East Lothian.<ref>
